violation_type.title: Fire- Extinguishing System (26 TAC §746.5301)
violation_type.typical_finding: The center did not have any fire extinguishers at the time of inspection because they were removed from the premises to get serviced the day before.     Note, this was corrected at inspection when several of the fire extinguishers were returned to the operation and had the service tag.

finding_variants.text: The center did not have any fire extinguishers at the time of inspection because they were removed from the premises to get serviced the day before.     Note, this was corrected at inspection when several of the fire extinguishers were returned to the operation and had the service tag.
There was no fire extinguisher at the operation. This was corrected at inspection by the operation placing a fire extinguisher in their mounted fire box.
There were no fire extinguishers mounted anywhere at the center at the time of inspection.
